description: Capacidade Instalada de Geração is a dataset listed in Brazilian national electricity system operator open data portal (ONS), an open data portal, published or maintained by ONS. Dados de potência nominal de Unidades Geradoras de Usinas despachadas pelo ONS, que são aquelas classificadas com modalidade de operação Tipo I, Tipo II-A, Tipo II-B e Tipo II-C. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Estes dados não possuem informações históricas. Os dados são lidos de suas origens e atualizado diariamente. Coverage: Brasil. The portal files it under the publisher ONS. Its tags are Dado Cadastral. It offers 5 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, PARQUET, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Atribuição. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ons-portal.
